fields.description: Issue includes an editorial on a poor winter season and business anxiety in the Greater Miami area, with discussion of tourism, vacancies, and local economic conditions. Coverage critiques Miami Herald classified advertising practices and includes a published letter from The Salvation Army responding to prior Miami Life reporting. Additional pieces address traffic control needs at busy intersections, garbage collection reductions and reported crime increases, municipal court fines (including gambling-related fines), and commentary on labor disputes and press fairness. The issue also contains a health feature arguing for cancer prevention and linking tobacco smoke to cancer, along with local entertainment and advertising content.
